# External Repositories & Agent Skills

This directory contains external reference repositories, vendor skills, and UI engineering guidelines imported into Grafting Monorepo.

## Integrated External Repositories

### 1. `emilkowalski-skills`
- **Source**: [`https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills`](https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills)
- **Author**: Emil Kowalski (ex-Vercel, ex-Linear, creator of Sonner and Cmdk)
- **Path**: `.ai/external/emilkowalski-skills`
- **Purpose**: Provides authoritative UI design engineering principles, micro-interaction guidelines, animation decision frameworks, and component craft rules ("Agents with Taste").
- **Key Skills Included**:
  - `emil-design-eng`: Inset shadows, scale(0.97) active states, custom cubic-bezier ease-out curves, origin-aware popovers.
  - `animate`: Duration limits (<200ms for UI), interruptible CSS transitions, spring physics.
  - `apple-design`: Fluid motion, gesture damping, interruptible state transitions.
  - `ask-sonner`: Toast and feedback notifications.
  - `pick-ui-library`: Vendor-neutral UI component evaluation.
